span.p: ADK (Google Agent Development Kit) — orchestration layer

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RIGHTS CUSTODIAN
artist identity, works, terms
SA: rights-custodian-sa@

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LICENSING NEGOTIATOR
ONE counterparty per session
SA: licensing-negotiator-sa@

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EVIDENCE AGENT
crawler logs, canaries
never claims training membership
SA: evidence-agent-sa@

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
REVOCATION PROPAGATOR
signed notices + receipts
SA: revocation-propagator-sa@

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT REGISTRY
publish · version · discover · scope
role-scoped discovery returns [ ] when unauthorized

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AGENT GATEWAY
routing + policy enforcement
every denial = structured PolicyDenialEvent, never silent

OTel exporter
span per agent decision:
agent.identity · policy.consulted · outcome

span.p:
APPEND-ONLY GRANT-EVENT LOG (Firestore)
grants · scopes · revocations · receipts
create()-only custom IAM role — no update, no delete
state = fold: resolve(grant_id, at=t)

span.p:
SUPERVISOR
deadline 5.0 s (derived from observed p95 2939 ms, ×1.7 headroom — metrics.json)
quarantine · reroute · circuit-break · TaskAbandoned

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No SA holds two of {identity, buyer terms, evidence, revocation}.
A monolith here would itself be the violation.
Numbers trace to /docs/metrics.json (2026-08-07 audit).
